# Home Assistant integration for UniFi Drive / UNAS v0.8.8 - HA 2026.10 compatibility maintenance

Patch release focused on Home Assistant `2026.10` compatibility maintenance.

## Changes

- Updates the current Home Assistant validation target to `2026.10.0`.
- Pins `pytest-homeassistant-custom-component` to `0.13.371`, the matching
  package line for Home Assistant `2026.10.0`.
- Keeps validation for the HACS-advertised Home Assistant `2024.8.0` minimum
  on Python `3.12`.
- Updates issue-template examples to the current Home Assistant release line.
- Confirms the current platforms avoid the relevant 2026.10 deprecated API
  paths.
- Adds a repository guard against the HA 2026.10 deprecated DeviceEntry
  multi-entry shim properties.
- Adds a validation-engine compatibility shim for the HA `2026.10` switch from
  standalone `voluptuous` to Probatio while keeping older HA support.
- Fixes a dynamic drive expansion payload shape where a single-pool UNAS reports
  all drives globally while the pool member list has not caught up yet.

## Notes

No new feature surface is included. Discovery, diagnostics, snapshot inventory
and optional local controls are unchanged.
